[ABOUT]
Muhammed Niyad is a Full-Stack Software Developer specializing in building scalable web, desktop, and mobile applications. He develops modern SaaS platforms, ERP-style business systems, AI-powered applications, REST APIs, and real-time software using the MERN stack, FastAPI, Flutter, Docker, and modern frontend technologies.

This website is a cinematic 3D portfolio designed to showcase software engineering projects, technical skills, freelance services, and professional experience.
